switch.name: fcs/pitch-damper-active
switch.test: fcs/pitch-stick-in ge -4.0 fcs/pitch-stick-in le 4.0 fcs/cas-pitch-enable ne 0.0

fcs_function.name: fcs/pitch-ratio-calc-0
fcs_function.description: Pitch Ratio: qbar schedule per NASA TM-72861 Fig 17 / MCAIR Eagle Talk. High qbar reduces stick-to-stab gearing to prevent overstress. Extended schedule to 1800 psf to maintain authority at high Mach. Minimum 0.25 ensures usable pitch control in supersonic flight.

fcs_function.name: fcs/ari/roll-rate-factor
fcs_function.description: CAS ARI roll rate scaling: |p| ramps 0→1 over 2-30 deg/s

fcs_function.name: fcs/ari/cas-demand-deg
fcs_function.description: CAS ARI: AOA schedule × roll rate factor, in degrees (×30)

fcs_function.name: fcs/diff-stab-total-deg
fcs_function.description: Differential stabilator: mechanical 0.3 coupling (converted to deg) + CAS series servo (deg).

switch.name: systems/hydraulics/emerg-gear-unlocked
switch.test: systems/hydraulics/jfs-accumulator-psi gt 200 gear/emergency-handle gt 0.7 gear/unit[0]/locked ne 0

switch.name: gear/unit[0]/locked
switch.test: systems/hydraulics/emerg-gear-unlocked ne 0 gear/emergency-handle gt 0.7 gear/emerg-pos lt 1

switch.name: gear/unit[0]/damaged
switch.test: position/aircraft-on-ground ne 0 position/aircraft-on-ground-last-value ne position/aircraft-on-ground velocities/h-dot-fps le -20 gear/unit[0]/WOW ne 0

switch.name: gear/unit[1]/damaged
switch.test: position/aircraft-on-ground ne 0 position/aircraft-on-ground-last-value ne position/aircraft-on-ground velocities/h-dot-fps le -20 gear/unit[1]/WOW ne 0

switch.name: gear/unit[2]/damaged
switch.test: position/aircraft-on-ground ne 0 position/aircraft-on-ground-last-value ne position/aircraft-on-ground velocities/h-dot-fps le -20 gear/unit[2]/WOW ne 0
